legs.rationale: Argentina's superior attacking output (17 goals vs England's 13, identical 6 conceded), Messi's historic eight-goal tournament form, and England's weakened centre-back pairing (Quansah suspended, Henderson absent) push Argentina's advancement probability to 0.56, well above the book's implied 0.333 on a 90-min price that must be settled on the ET result.

slips.rationale: Argentina to advance at 3.00 offers a 22.7-point edge over the book's ET-equivalent implied probability; the only qualifying leg today after line-shopping eliminates England home as the lower-edge side of the same market.
